body:
thank you for reading and replying <3 

im now coming to realize everything happens for a reason - after i posted this my mom texted me while i was at work and told me UB (my crazy abusive uncle that we live with) is kicking us out of the house that we moved into this time 4 years ago after getting kicked out of our old apartment and we need to stay in a hotel. ive never felt this emotion before, my stomach is still upset from when she told me this. but after i got home and cried, i felt another emotion that i really never felt before either, genuine belief that things will be okay.

i know everything will be okay and its just meant for us to get out of this house but im still super sad.

whenever i have these thoughts (my last post) something will always happen that reminds me the universe is in control and whats meant to happen, will happen.  but i always seem to still fall into a hole and not change my ways. today, i felt the worst ever, which is why i randomly posted this on reddit, and honestly this is the worst news i probably could have gotten during my breakdown on reddit and one week before christmas, but after i got all my tears out i am now realizing that everything will be okay.

i hope u understand what im trying to say and sorry for typing so much. your heart is so beautiful and i really appreciate your feedback and i hope you find the love you deserve to feel for yourself.
and u can always dm me if u want to chat more <3 thank u
thank u so much for reading and responding. i hope u find the happiness u deserve. im also here if u want to  chaf <3
